stages.title: Data & SQL Foundations
stages.description: Build the vocabulary and mental models required before choosing a database engine.

stages.title: Relational Databases
stages.description: Move from embedded SQL practice to production-grade relational database platforms.

stages.title: NoSQL, Search & Application Data
stages.description: Understand non-relational data models and choose systems by access pattern rather than fashion.

stages.title: Warehousing & Analytical Databases
stages.description: Shift from transactional workloads to dimensional modeling and column-oriented analytics.

stages.title: Data Formats, Storage & Distributed Systems
stages.description: Learn the substrate underneath modern warehouses, lakes, streaming systems, and compute engines.

stages.title: Hadoop Ecosystem
stages.description: Study the foundational ecosystem that established distributed storage and batch processing at scale.

stages.title: Distributed Compute & Federated SQL
stages.description: Process large datasets and query heterogeneous systems using modern distributed engines.

stages.title: Event Streaming & Real-Time Processing
stages.description: Design durable event backbones and stateful processing pipelines for data in motion.

stages.title: Integration, CDC & Orchestration
stages.description: Move, synchronize, transform, test, and schedule data across complete engineering workflows.

stages.title: Lakehouse Table Formats
stages.description: Add transactions, schema evolution, time travel, and dependable metadata to object-storage data lakes.

stages.title: Cloud & Managed Data Platforms
stages.description: Apply earlier concepts in managed platforms that offer permanent no-cost learning paths.

stages.title: Exploration & Visualization
stages.description: Finish the path by exposing governed data through interactive, SQL-driven analytics.
